name: Rowan's mother
description: Eriette's sister and a witch, killed by Rowan's father after she tried to drink Rowan and Will's blood.

timeline.summary: Eriette is revealed to be Rowan's aunt, sister of the mother who tried to drink Rowan's blood, and tells her she can redeem their line.
timeline.quote: "Your mother was the cruelest of us.

relations.note: Eriette calls Rowan's mother one of her sisters
relations.quote: "My sisters have never been known for their wisdom—only their ambition,"
